newsitem.title: USA: Kmart completes $335 million debt sale.
newsitem.headline: Kmart completes $335 million debt sale.

text.p: Kmart Corp said Wednesday it had completed the sale of $335 million in commercial mortgaged-backed securities, which brought the company proceeds of $331.7 million.
Kmart said it will use the proceeds to refinance bank debt.
The weighted average coupon of the floating rate financing is London Interbank Offered Rate (LIBOR) plus 47 basis points.
Under the transaction, Kmart sold 81 store properties to a wholly owned real estate trust which issued the debt securities and sold them to institutional investors.
